annotations.title: Get the booking link for an empty leg flight

description: Return the public SkyAccess listing page link for a specific empty leg flight, where the traveler can review the flight and continue on skyaccess.com. This is read-only: it creates no booking, hold or payment, and it does not modify or cancel anything. It sends no traveler details to SkyAccess and does not ask a specialist to make contact.

flightId.description: The SkyAccess empty leg flight id, as given in the `flightId` field of a flight listing
